title: Cortex Memory Fact
description: Schema for atomic facts extracted during compaction events. Each fact is one line in .cortex/facts.jsonl. Designed for future embedding/retrieval consumption.

type.description: Fact category. decision: choice with rationale. preference: behavioral pattern. constraint: hard limit. pattern: approach that worked/failed. blocker: active/resolved blocker. context_pointer: reference to where info lives.

slug.description: Active Cortex slug when this fact was extracted

text.description: The atomic fact content — one discrete piece of information

source.description: File path or source identifier where this fact was found

extracted_at.description: Compact ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of extraction

session_context.description: Optional context about the session state when extracted
